findings.title: VALIDATED — generalized fixed-window audio-classification eval turns an unsupported task into meaningful L3 support without model-specific branching or a universal dataset
findings.observation: On current-main commit 67169d45c40ed8326065e87ed29d19623b79cbb4, `winml eval --task audio-classification` failed before dataset loading with `Task 'audio-classification' is not supported`. Draft #1326 generalized the task registry/schema and evaluator rather than branching on onecxi/open-vakgyata or installing a universal dataset. For rank-2 waveform graphs, the evaluator decodes raw audio with SoundFile, downmixes channels, rationally resamples to the checkpoint rate, normalizes, processes every consecutive static ONNX window, right-pads only the final window, runs one forward per window, computes one arithmetic mean over window logits per utterance, and decodes a single argmax through checkpoint id2label. For rank-3+ static feature graphs, it preserves the extracted tensor and validates non-batch dimensions rather than flattening into waveform windows. It filters aligned labels before bounded selection and reports requested, eligible, selected, processed, rejected, rejection-reason, and per-label counts. The accepted 2026-08-22 candidate stacked directly on exact Draft #1326 head 1bd919b583aa8ccd974e35fa6a1a132ac7e1c9f8 and passed a pinned FP32 CPU FLEURS smoke over nine utterances: 9 requested/eligible/selected/processed, 0 rejected, 133 total one-second windows, 7 to 27 windows per utterance, and one prediction per utterance. Full quality gates also passed: Ruff, mypy over 439 source files, 3,640 command/config/build/compiler/session/eval tests, and 1,538 model/loader/dataset/export tests. The earlier 90-row-per-precision evidence remains valid historical breadth; the current run is the bounded final-candidate smoke required by the charter.
